metadata.description: Claude Code mods: workers (OpenRouter or Bedrock, panes or tabs) with team messaging, agent progress bars, a live agent file map, context/usage meters, quick settings, skins.

plugins.name: agent-map
plugins.description: Live project file tree showing which file each agent (main, subagents, cheap workers) is editing (red 🔨) and what's ready for review (green ✓)

plugins.name: agent-progress
plugins.description: Animated per-agent progress bars (main agent, subagents, cheap-worker workers) driven by their task lists

plugins.name: cheap-worker
plugins.description: Spin up Claude Code workers from a picker: OpenRouter (any model) or Amazon Bedrock (Claude), as tmux panes or terminal tabs; team messaging between them

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Live context-window bar above the prompt: fill, compaction point and what fills it

plugins.name: cw-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of driver-seat cheap workers: running tasks, cost, fail and escalation rates from workers.tsv

plugins.name: driver-seat-guard
plugins.description: Learn mode: one-step pacing, no unasked web search, no work on todos you haven't reached

plugins.name: evidence-band
plugins.description: On status/audit prompts: require doc + file:line citations and show which sources Claude actually read

plugins.name: quick-settings
plugins.description: A button under the prompt that opens a pane to switch /model and /effort; add a setting by adding one control

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Colour skins for all of Claude Code (Noir, Tokyo Night, Dracula, Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Everforest, Nordic, Monokai) as custom themes, picked from a pane

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Five-hour and weekly plan usage as one line under the prompt, with reset countdown and pace forecast
